attrs.text: **OAuth authorization needs a browser that reaches the Host web server directly** — the callback is that server's own origin: its bind address and port, over HTTPS when it serves TLS. A browser that reaches DSH only through a proxy or the Web app's `publicUrl` cannot finish authorization. A dynamic client registration is keyed by that callback, so a changed bind address or port, or a random port, registers a new client at the next explicit authorization; sign-out keeps the previous registration record.

attrs.text: **There is no batch-wide native-search counter** — `searchMaxQueries` bounds `ctx.web.search` calls, but a provider may perform several native searches inside each call; for example a model-backed provider configured with `maxUses` can permit up to `searchMaxQueries × maxUses` native searches, and `searchMaxResults` limits only the combined sources returned to the caller. Deployments control cost through these independent consumer and provider settings because the service does not know provider-internal search units.

A provider rate limit therefore fails the call; [`dsh-web-deepseek-api`](../web-deepseek-api/README.md#known-limitations-and-deferred-work) paces its own Search requests to the account's 5 QPS limit within one process.

Deployments that need per-call confirmation must add a `tools/pre-execute` policy or disable fetch.

title: Search pacing limits send times within one plugin instance. Other processes and clients on the same account share the account-wide 5 QPS limit without coordination, and network jitter can still bunch arrivals; an HTTP 429 fails that search,...

attrs.text: Search pacing limits send times within one plugin instance. Other processes and clients on the same account share the account-wide 5 QPS limit without coordination, and network jitter can still bunch arrivals; an HTTP 429 fails that search, and `dsh-tool-web` then fails the whole multi-query call. Fetch is not paced, so parallel `web_fetch` calls can exceed the Fetch limit.

Another adapter registered as `deepseek-official` or `deepseek-account`, such as a test replay adapter, counts as no DeepSeek route: under `auto` billing its conversations send `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` to the official base and, without a key, the account credential, and `account` billing asks the account service as it does without the account route.

title: **Provider selection cannot see a missing key** — the synchronous availability check can establish that a resolver exists but cannot query an asynchronous credential store, so `ctx.web` still selects a keyless provider and a direct search f...

attrs.text: **Provider selection cannot see a missing key** — the synchronous availability check can establish that a resolver exists but cannot query an asynchronous credential store, so `ctx.web` still selects a keyless provider and a direct search fails with `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`; the asynchronous `ready()` affects only which model requests are offered `web_search`.

title: **Readiness checks presence, not validity** — a wrong key, or an endpoint without the native `web_search_20250305` server tool, counts as ready, so `web_search` stays offered and each call fails with a structured error.

attrs.text: **Readiness checks presence, not validity** — a wrong key, or an endpoint without the native `web_search_20250305` server tool, counts as ready, so `web_search` stays offered and each call fails with a structured error.

title: **Search does not follow the chat endpoint** — when the official route chats through a gateway, search still sends its key to the configured search endpoint, the official one by default, and fails unless that endpoint accepts the key.

attrs.text: **Search does not follow the chat endpoint** — when the official route chats through a gateway, search still sends its key to the configured search endpoint, the official one by default, and fails unless that endpoint accepts the key.

title: **Over-returned sources still cost tokens** — with no result-count knob on the wire, `maxResults` is enforced only post-hoc by service truncation.

attrs.text: **Over-returned sources still cost tokens** — with no result-count knob on the wire, `maxResults` is enforced only post-hoc by service truncation.

title: **A source's `snippet` depends on the endpoint** — it is the excerpt the endpoint returns with the result item, or else a text-block citation (`cited_text`) matching its URL; an Anthropic-compatible endpoint that returns neither yields sour...

attrs.text: **A source's `snippet` depends on the endpoint** — it is the excerpt the endpoint returns with the result item, or else a text-block citation (`cited_text`) matching its URL; an Anthropic-compatible endpoint that returns neither yields sources without snippets.

title: **No availability observation** — `listProviders()` and `web/providers-changed` report which providers are registered, not whether they are usable; there is no capability-status query, and `searchReady()` and `fetchReady()` report only the ...

attrs.text: **No availability observation** — `listProviders()` and `web/providers-changed` report which providers are registered, not whether they are usable; there is no capability-status query, and `searchReady()` and `fetchReady()` report only the selected provider's credential readiness and answer true when selection fails. Availability is observable only by running a search or fetch and routing the thrown code, and the no-provider failure is the generic `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` with no per-provider reason enumeration ([Agent Note](../../../.agents/notes/archived/simplification/2026-07-04-drop-unconsumed-web-observation-surface.md)).

title: **Search requests carry only `query`, `maxResults`, and `llmProvider`** — provider-neutral controls (recency, domain filters, regional hints, search depth) are deferred until the backends can honor them ([seam Agent Note](../../../.agents/n...

attrs.text: **Search requests carry only `query`, `maxResults`, and `llmProvider`** — provider-neutral controls (recency, domain filters, regional hints, search depth) are deferred until the backends can honor them ([seam Agent Note](../../../.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-06-24-web-capability-seam.md)).

title: **`WebFetchBody` has no `pdf` arm** — text-extractable PDF support is named deferred work; the closed union makes adding it a compile-enforced change across the web packages.

attrs.text: **`WebFetchBody` has no `pdf` arm** — text-extractable PDF support is named deferred work; the closed union makes adding it a compile-enforced change across the web packages.

title: **The per-route search preference is fixed** — the two DeepSeek model routes and the two DeepSeek search provider ids are constants of this package, so a deployment changes the outcome only by configuring `searchProvider`, and a provider-ne...

attrs.text: **The per-route search preference is fixed** — the two DeepSeek model routes and the two DeepSeek search provider ids are constants of this package, so a deployment changes the outcome only by configuring `searchProvider`, and a provider-neutral rule is deferred until a second pair of routes and providers needs one.
